title: AutoComplete vs InstantSearch Result Count
body:
Afternoon,

Question I have on search result discrepancies between AutoComplete and InstantSearch. We're seeing a different count of results based on which tool is used.

The difference appears to be related to `&is_v=1` in the URL. I have read that this is for versioning, but I am seeing different results when this is present versus not.

For instance, a search using AutoComplete returns 14 results. The same search performed with InstantSearch (when that parameter is present) is 9. When I remove that parameter from the URL but perform the same search from InstantSearch I get 14 results.

Is there a way to normalize these results?

Thanks,
Brian
